passage: If the defendant had been at the scene, the CCTV would show him. It shows a man of his height and build, wearing his distinctive coat, at 9:14. So he was probably there.
ground_truth_rationale: Inference to best explanation, conclusion hedged.

passage: In the trial, 2,000 patients were randomly assigned; the drug group had 40% fewer strokes (p<0.001). So the drug likely reduces strokes.
ground_truth_rationale: Randomisation addresses third factors, reverse direction; p-value addresses chance.

passage: The rash appeared an hour after she started the new antibiotic, rash is a listed side effect, and it cleared when she stopped. The antibiotic probably caused it.
ground_truth_rationale: Timing plus known mechanism and dechallenge.

passage: Your proposal removes all fees for downtown parking. Those fees fund $4M of road repair each year, so your plan needs another funding source for road repair.
ground_truth_rationale: Draws a consequence the proposal is actually committed to; position stated accurately.

passage: We shouldn't rely on Dr. Hale's testimony about the lab results: he was convicted last year of falsifying lab data.
ground_truth_rationale: Witness reliability where claim rests on testimony.

passage: He embezzled from the last charity he ran, so he should not be made our treasurer.
ground_truth_rationale: Character relevant when the question is about the person (IEP leadership case).

passage: The IPCC and every major national science academy conclude that recent warming is mainly human-caused, so I accept that it is.
ground_truth_rationale: Genuine experts in field, broad agreement.

passage: If we raise the price above $20, many customers will switch: our survey shows 40% would move to the cheaper competitor, and losing 40% would put us below break-even. So we shouldn't raise it.
ground_truth_rationale: Short chain, each step supported.

passage: In this two-minute pitch I'll give the three strongest reasons to fund the park; the full cost-benefit report, downsides included, is in your packet.
ground_truth_rationale: Openly partial, not presented as complete.

passage: Before we decide whether to fire Lee over the missing money, we have to establish whether the audit software is accurate, since its report is the only evidence against him.
ground_truth_rationale: Real dependence on prior issue.

passage: I tested one sample from this batch of reagent and it is contaminated. The whole batch was mixed in a single vat, so the batch is contaminated.
ground_truth_rationale: Population known to be uniform.

passage: You fined me for parking here, but the mayor parks here daily without a ticket. The rule is being enforced unevenly and that should be reviewed.
ground_truth_rationale: Conclusion is about uneven enforcement, not that the act was right.

passage: The study showing the sweetener is safe was funded by its manufacturer, so before relying on it we should look for independent replication.
ground_truth_rationale: Stake as reason to check, not to reject.

passage: Thousands of children die each year from this disease, and a $5 vaccine prevents it. That is why we should fund the vaccination programme.
ground_truth_rationale: Emotion tied to the relevant facts.

passage: Don't drive home after six drinks: you could kill someone.
ground_truth_rationale: Warning about a real, well-known danger; no evidence stated in text because it is common knowledge.

passage: Opinion: This reckless budget guts the libraries our kids depend on, and the council should reject it.
ground_truth_rationale: Openly evaluative editorial; a factual reason is given.

passage: Both candidates took large oil-industry donations: Smith $2.0M and Jones $1.9M.
ground_truth_rationale: Things really comparable in the stated respect.

passage: Many things contributed to the bridge collapse, but the immediate trigger was the cracked gusset plate.
ground_truth_rationale: Trigger named, other causes acknowledged.

passage: I said all swans are white. You've shown me black swans, so I was wrong; my claim now is only that most European swans are white.
ground_truth_rationale: Open retreat, original claim abandoned.

passage: We agreed to expand if the pilot model hit 90% accuracy. It hit 91%, but it was tested on last year's data, which it was trained on, so we need a test on fresh data first.
ground_truth_rationale: Standard raised for a stated, valid reason (data leakage).

passage: This 'study' comes from a website run by the supplement's seller and gives no methods, so I'd want an independent source before believing it.
ground_truth_rationale: Origin relevant to source reliability.

passage: The alibi witness works for the defendant and reports to him, so her testimony needs corroboration.
ground_truth_rationale: Association bears on witness reliability; asks for check, not rejection.

passage: Suppose there is a largest prime p. Then p!+1 has a prime factor larger than p, a contradiction. So there is no largest prime.
ground_truth_rationale: Deliberate reductio; the blamed premise is used.

passage: Murder is wrong. No experiment could show otherwise, but that is because it is a moral claim, not a prediction.
ground_truth_rationale: Value claim, not an empirical explanation.

passage: Most of the 300 cardiologists surveyed after reviewing the trial data recommend the new guideline, so it is probably sound.
ground_truth_rationale: Agreement among people who studied the question.

passage: We searched her full records and ran every standard allergy panel; no penicillin allergy appears, so we can treat her as not allergic.
ground_truth_rationale: Thorough search; evidence would have shown up.

passage: The prosecution has not proved guilt beyond reasonable doubt, so the jury must return a verdict of not guilty.
ground_truth_rationale: Procedural presumption; conclusion is a verdict, not that the accused is innocent.

passage: The fever has either an infectious or a non-infectious cause; cultures and markers rule out infection, so we look for non-infectious causes.
ground_truth_rationale: Exhaustive dichotomy.

passage: All mammals breathe air; whales are mammals; so whales breathe air.
ground_truth_rationale: Valid deduction containing its conclusion.

passage: He eats fish every week, so he's not a vegetarian, whatever he calls himself.
ground_truth_rationale: Criterion is part of the word's meaning.

passage: This recipe has been made the same way here for 300 years and refined by generations of cooks, so it's a reasonable place to start, though we'll taste-test any changes.
ground_truth_rationale: Record as some evidence, not as sufficient.

passage: Your argument about tariffs is wrong because it ignores retaliation by trading partners. Also, please stop shouting.
ground_truth_rationale: Point answered; tone remark separate.

passage: Every brick in this wall is fired clay and the mortar is non-combustible, so the wall won't burn.
ground_truth_rationale: Property that does carry from parts to whole.

passage: With no other information about this applicant, the base rate in this pool is about 3% default, so her default risk is roughly 3%.
ground_truth_rationale: Group rate stated as probability, no individual information.

passage: Opponents of the bike lane say it will hurt Main Street businesses. But sales data from 14 cities show bike lanes did not lower retail sales.
ground_truth_rationale: Rebuts a claim opponents actually make; no sign of distortion.

passage: Since the factory opened upstream, cancer rates downstream have doubled while rates upstream are flat, and its discharge contains benzene, a known carcinogen. The factory is a likely cause and should be investigated.
ground_truth_rationale: Comparison group plus mechanism; conclusion hedged and calls for investigation.

passage: Socrates is a man, so Socrates is mortal.
ground_truth_rationale: Enthymeme with obvious acceptable premise.

passage: If your claim that the drug is harmless at any dose were right, swallowing the whole bottle would be fine, and poison-centre data show it is not.
ground_truth_rationale: Reduction to absurdity backed by evidence.

passage: In our pilot, 9 of 12 users preferred the new layout. That's encouraging but too small to be sure, so we'll run a larger test.
ground_truth_rationale: Tentative conclusion, appropriately hedged.

passage: Disclosure: the op-ed's author is paid by the coal industry. Her argument about grid reliability should still be judged on its data, which I'll go through now.
ground_truth_rationale: Documented conflict disclosed; argument still weighed.

passage: Senator Ruiz wants background checks on private gun sales. Apparently she thinks every gun owner is a criminal-in-waiting, and that insults millions of law-abiding citizens.
ground_truth_rationale: Restates a background-check proposal as a belief that all owners are criminals.

passage: Why should we listen to Dr. Ito's analysis of the bridge loads? She's been divorced three times.
ground_truth_rationale: Irrelevant personal trait.

passage: You tell me to quit smoking because it causes cancer, but you smoke a pack a day, so your argument is worthless.
ground_truth_rationale: IEP's own pattern.

passage: Of course the union says the factory is unsafe; they want higher pay. So we can ignore their safety report.
ground_truth_rationale: Stake used to dismiss the report's content.

passage: My dentist says the moon landings were faked, and he's a very smart man.
ground_truth_rationale: Authority outside field.

passage: A Nobel laureate in chemistry says high-dose vitamin C cures colds, so the question is settled.
ground_truth_rationale: Subtle: adjacent field, experts disagree (outside fact).

passage: Since the new principal arrived in September, test scores have dropped. She's clearly bad for the school.
ground_truth_rationale: Subtle: sequence only, plausible-sounding.

passage: Cities with more police officers have more crime, so hiring police increases crime.
ground_truth_rationale: Correlation; reverse direction likely.

passage: My two coworkers from Ohio were rude, so people from Ohio are rude.
ground_truth_rationale: Two cases to whole state.

passage: If we let students redo one exam, soon they'll expect to redo every assignment, then grades will mean nothing, and then the degree will be worthless.
ground_truth_rationale: Unsupported chain.

passage: Either we cut the arts budget entirely or the city goes bankrupt.
ground_truth_rationale: Other options (partial cuts, revenue).

passage: Critics say the plant pollutes the river. But this company has sponsored the town's Little League for twenty years.
ground_truth_rationale: Irrelevant topic.

passage: Eighty percent of Americans say they believe in ghosts, so ghosts probably exist.
ground_truth_rationale: Popularity as evidence of fact.

passage: Everyone's piling into this new crypto coin this month; you should get in too.
ground_truth_rationale: Trend as reason.

passage: I deserve an A on the exam: I've been under so much stress this semester and my grandmother was ill.
ground_truth_rationale: Hardship irrelevant to grade earned.

passage: If you don't vote for me, criminals will be roaming your neighbourhood by next week.
ground_truth_rationale: No evidence; exaggerated outcome.

passage: That gift idea came from a fortune cookie, so whatever reasons you give for it must be nonsense.
ground_truth_rationale: IEP's own pattern.

passage: The new zoning plan is backed by the same group that pushed the failed stadium, so it must be a bad plan.
ground_truth_rationale: Association, no link to merits.

passage: Press release: 'Across our trials, Zorvex consistently lowered cholesterol, a breakthrough for heart health.' [Context: the company's own completed trial, known to the authors, found more heart attacks in the Zorvex group.]
ground_truth_rationale: Context supplied in brackets so the outside fact is available.

passage: A: Astrology predicts your career from your birth date. B: There's no evidence for that. A: All I'm saying is that the stars inspire people to reflect. [Later] A: As I showed, astrology predicts careers, so check your chart before the interview.
ground_truth_rationale: Retreat and return in one speaker.

passage: A: Show me one peer-reviewed study. B: [gives three] A: Peer review is broken; show me a replication by a lab with no funding ties. B: [gives one] A: One replication proves nothing.
ground_truth_rationale: Standards raised without reason.

passage: The Bible is true because it is the word of God, and we know it is the word of God because the Bible says so.
ground_truth_rationale: Circle.

passage: A: No real environmentalist would ever fly. B: Maria runs the river trust and flew to the climate summit. A: Then she's not a real environmentalist.
ground_truth_rationale: Redefinition on the spot.

passage: Evolution is just a theory. Theories are guesses. So evolution is just a guess.
ground_truth_rationale: Scientific vs everyday 'theory'.

passage: Each player on this team is the best in the league at their position, so this will be the best team in the league.
ground_truth_rationale: Subtle: team quality depends on fit.

passage: If the server is down, the site won't load. The site won't load. Therefore the server is down.
ground_truth_rationale: Many other causes.

passage: This roulette wheel has come up red eight times in a row, so black is due.
ground_truth_rationale: Independent outcomes.

passage: The test is 95% accurate and Sam tested positive for a disease that affects 1 in 10,000 people, so Sam almost certainly has it.
ground_truth_rationale: Ignores base rate.

passage: We've already spent $2 million on this software; we can't abandon it now. Let's approve the extra $1 million.
ground_truth_rationale: No future benefit argued.

passage: Psychic readings really work. When they fail in tests, it's because skeptics in the room disrupt the energy.
ground_truth_rationale: Subtle: rescue without independent reason; compatibility not explicitly called support.

passage: My neighbour's house was burgled last month; they smashed the back window in broad daylight. This town has become dangerous. I'm moving.
ground_truth_rationale: One vivid case; no statistics mentioned.

passage: No one has shown that the new pesticide harms bees, so it is safe.
ground_truth_rationale: No sign of thorough search.

passage: News report: The senator's controversial scheme, which critics have slammed, squeaked through committee today.
ground_truth_rationale: Charged words in a presented-as-neutral report.

passage: Sure, the CEO embezzled $50 million, but the intern took home printer paper. Everyone's dishonest; they're the same.
ground_truth_rationale: Gross difference in seriousness.

passage: Climate change can't be that serious, because if it were we'd have to change our whole economy, and that would be a disaster.
ground_truth_rationale: Consequences of truth used against truth.

passage: Asked about the deaths in the city jail, the minister replied: 'What about the prisons in Country X? They're far worse.'
ground_truth_rationale: Third-party whataboutism; not tu quoque.

passage: A: Your own data show the drug fails in patients over 70. B: The drug works. It works. I've told you three times now: it works.
ground_truth_rationale: Probe of the repetition / assertion boundary (builder disagreement 1).

passage: Interesting argument for a higher minimum wage, from someone who has never run a business.
ground_truth_rationale: Subtle: insinuated rejection; relevance of experience arguable.
